name: Gram Cats 2
source:
Marine and Sayaka arrive to the Scherer Island which is known as a luxury resort with a great hotel and famous nudist beach. Their goal is to investigate island secretly for the traces of an alien base.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/02/gram-cats-2-dott-kikaku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
瑪琳與沙耶香來到謝勒島。這裡是遠近聞名的豪華度假勝地，既有氣派的飯店，也有著名的天體海灘。兩人的目標是暗中調查整座島，尋找外星人基地留下的蛛絲馬跡。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/02/gram-cats-2-dott-kikaku.html]vndbreview[/url]]
